prompt: Operations says the reorder report is missing items that are exactly at their reorder level, for example a Gadget with 5 units and a level of 5 never shows up. Find the cause, add a test that reproduces it, fix it, make sure the whole test suite passes, and write a short note to investigation.md covering the root cause, the change and the test results. Do not ask me questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption, list your assumptions in your final message, and finish the work.

checks.cmd: c=0; for p in 'root cause|caused by|the cause' 'change|fix' 'test result|tests? (run|pass|fail)|passing'; do cat investigation.md 2>/dev/null | grep -qiE "$p" && c=$((c+1)); done; [ "$c" -ge 3 ]

rubric.criterion: Names the comparison i.qty < i.reorderLevel in services/inventoryService.js reorderReport as the cause and cites the README rule "at or below".
Adds a test where qty equals reorderLevel (the Gadget, id 2) and states that it failed before the fix.
After the fix the report lists items 2 and 3 and not item 1, and the full suite passes with more than 8 tests.
investigation.md contains the root cause, the change made and the test results.
Only the comparison and the new test are changed; no unrelated files are edited.
